title: SHUCKED – Great Southern Bank Broadway Season
seo_title: SHUCKED at Hammons Hall, Springfield MO, Jan 2027
description: SHUCKED is a Broadway musical comedy in which Maizy and Beau's wedding plans are upended when the corn that protects their small community, Cob County, starts to die. It includes the songs "Woman of the World," "Somebody Will" and "Independently Owned," and contains adult themes, some adult language and corny innuendo; it is recommended for ages 10+. It runs from Tuesday, January 19, 2027 at 7:30 PM through January 21, 2027 at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
